items.headline: Winter Camp: Sign Up Now
items.body: Elite FC Winter Camp runs Dec. 27–31, 9:30 a.m. to 2 p.m., and it's open to all levels: footwork, technical and tactical drills, and games. Dec. 27 starts with a swag giveaway. K2 Fitness runs strength and conditioning on Dec. 28 and 30. On Dec. 29, a professional instructor leads yoga and breath control for competition, and lunch is served. Crepes on Dec. 31 celebrate the end of camp and 2026. Call it a tune-up for the second half of the season, or a good excuse to escape visiting relatives for a few hours. If you're going, let the club know as soon as possible for a headcount; contact the club for price and sign-up.

items.headline: Cobra Challenge details (Frank asked: more details; has the deadline passed?)
items.body: USA Fencing tournament page 12119 (via fencing-api live, Oct 26 4:26 PM ET): Cobra Challenge SYC/RCC, hosted by Cobra Fencing Club, Meadowlands Expo Center, 355 Plaza Drive, Secaucus NJ. Regular-fee entry deadline Sun Nov 1 (NOT passed); late fee period Nov 2-7; online entry closes after Nov 7. All events capped; full events go to a waitlist (free, but a payment method is required to be officially on it; 'pending' = not on the waitlist). Cap adjustments from about Oct 29. Close-of-check-in times subject to change; final times posted no later than Nov 1. Venue opens 6:30 a.m. each day; arrive 1 hour before close of check-in. Free parking in adjacent garages. No Wi-Fi in the venue; results only on fencingtimelive.com. Event-fee refund requests by midnight Nov 20. Medals to top 8. Fees: regular $35 registration + $9 sanction + $3 admin + $90/event; late $70 + $9 + $9 + $180/event.
items.vet_notes: Official USA Fencing page via Frank's API; detail for Frank's slot note on signup-3. Used only to answer his question + a boxnote under the approved Cobra board (fees not printed).
